description: Red Peatonal Pereira is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Pereira, Risaralda. Red peatonal de la ciudad de Pereira, que tiene la finalidad de conectar el territorio urbano de manera a nodos de comunicación, equipamientos y espacios públicos queden al alcance del ciudadano que se desplaza a pie. Coverage: Pereira, Risaralda. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Pereira, Risaralda. Its tags are movilidad, caminata, territorio. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Vivienda, Ciudad y Territorio. The portal shows 2024-06-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
